about: Where a chamber lets its members take a bill from a committee that will not report it, and how many must sign. A chamber not listed has no such rule in the data yet (the states' rules are not researched).
source: Rules of the House of Representatives, rule XV, clause 2: a motion to discharge a committee is entered on the petition of a majority of the Members, 218 of 435 (U.S. House of Representatives, Rules of the House, 119th Congress).
